map.由主半径与管半径求环体体积: Torus volume from the major and tube radii
map.输入主半径 R（到管中心）与管半径 r，求环体体积。: Enter the major radius R (to the tube centre) and tube radius r to get the torus volume.
map.📖 查看「由主半径与管半径求环体体积 使用指南」: 📖 View Guide: "Torus volume from the major and tube radii"
map.环面零件：管道弯头、环形密封件容积: Torus parts: volumes of pipe elbows and ring seals
map.甜甜圈形容器：环面体容积估算: Doughnut vessels: volume estimates for toroidal bodies
map.数学模型：环体体积与管径的平方关系: Math model: the square relation between torus volume and tube diameter
map.算法：环体体积 V=2π²·R·r²，R 为主半径（圆心到管中心）、r 为管半径: Algorithm: torus volume V=2·pi2·R·r2, with R the major radius (centre to tube centre) and r the tube radius; equivalently the tube cross-section pi·r2 times the swept circumference 2·pi·R. Requires R,r>0.
map.例：R=5m、r=1m → V=2π²×5×1=98.696 m³。若 r=2m: Example: R=5m, r=1m gives V=2·pi2 x 5 x 1=98.696 m3. With r=2m (same R=5), V=2·pi2 x 5 x 4=394.784 m3 (doubling the tube diameter quadruples the volume because of r2).
map.R 和 r 别搞混？: Don't mix up R and r?
map.R 是\"大半径\"（圆环中心圈）、r 是\"小管半径\"（管粗细）；管截面是半: R is the large radius (the ring's centre circle) and r the small tube radius (tube thickness); the tube cross-section is a circle of radius r whose centre sweeps a circle of radius R to form the torus.
map.环体表面积 S=4π²Rr；与体积类似（截面积周长 2πr × 绕行周长 2πR: Torus surface area S=4·pi2·R·r, analogous to the volume (cross-section circumference 2·pi·r times the swept circumference 2·pi·R). This tool gives the volume; compute the surface area with this formula separately.
